metadata.description: Plugins by Egor Fedorov: context-optimizer (a live cost and context meter, Haiku subagents, handoffs and document digests for chat) and cco-arcade.

plugins.name: context-optimizer
plugins.description: See what Claude costs you and spend less of it. In chat: hand a long chat over to a new one, digest long documents, set up Projects, check tokens, sharpen prompts. In Claude Code: a live line with context, cost, plan limits and the cache countdown; Haiku 5.5 subagents for reading and test runs; /cco audit of your own transcripts. Local, no telemetry.

plugins.name: cco-arcade
plugins.description: The waiting game for Claude Code: live session dashboard + idle 'Token City' fed by your real agent activity (Godzilla wrecks it if you stop coding), plus desktop/phone pings when Claude finishes or needs you
